name: audit2e fs readdir sorted promises constants and callbacks
source: import * as fs from "node:fs"; import * as os from "node:os"; async function main(): Promise<void> { const d = fs.mkdtempSync(os.tmpdir() + "/fixe-"); for (const n of ["a", "B", "10", "9", "é"]) fs.writeFileSync(d + "/" + n, "1"); console.log(fs.readdirSync(d)); fs.writeFileSync(d + "/b.bin", Buffer.from([1, 2, 3, 4])); console.log(fs.readFileSync(d + "/b.bin", "hex"), fs.readFileSync(d + "/b.bin", { encoding: "base64" }), fs.statSync(d + "/zzz", { throwIfNoEntry: false })); console.log(fs.constants.R_OK, fs.F_OK, fs.R_OK, fs.W_OK, fs.X_OK); await fs.promises.writeFile(d + "/p.txt", "promised"); console.log(await fs.promises.readFile(d + "/p.txt", "utf8"), (await fs.promises.stat(d + "/p.txt")).size); await new Promise<void>((res) => fs.stat(d + "/p.txt", (err, st) => { console.log(err, st.size); res(); })); await new Promise<void>((res) => fs.readdir(d, (err, names) => { console.log(err, names.length); res(); })); await new Promise<void>((res) => fs.exists(d + "/p.txt", (ex) => { console.log(ex); res(); })); fs.accessSync(d + "/p.txt"); fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true }); }
